newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.7 bln for Tuesday, March 11.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.7 bln for Tuesday, March 11.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thrusady, March 11 are expected to total $1.7 billion in 34 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $908 million in 17 sales, with a $190 million Houston issue through Lehman Brothers topping the list.
On the competitive side, 17 sales totaling $838 million are on the schedule, a $556 million Pennsylvania deal is the largest at 1100 EST.
An additional four sales totaling $87 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
